name: paseo-cto
description: Provider-neutral, release-driven CTO operating model for Claude Code and Codex: delegate bounded outcomes to isolated agents; budget reasoning effort, validation, context, and reporting without weakening risk-based review; integrate only source-linked evidence; and report in the project-configured language. Models and effort ranges remain owner decisions.

interface.shortDescription: Run a release-driven Paseo engineering organization
interface.longDescription: Operate the same CTO-led Paseo organization in Codex or Claude. The CTO keeps the nearest shippable outcome and critical path explicit, delegates bounded work to isolated agents, selects the minimum adequate effort within owner-approved ranges, avoids duplicate validation and context, applies risk-based review at delegated-write and closure gates, and uses source-linked durable evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use $paseo-cto:paseo-cto to advance the nearest shippable product outcome, reconcile the fleet, and keep the living plan current.
